commits.message:
fix(renderer): review high — overlapping turns stated, one logfmt field type, the answer's settle holds only what it records (candybar-host-renderer-x96a.2xo)

- The interface no longer claims one input at a time: a request's turn waits
  inside itself until the mailbox holds that wait, so turns overlap.
- The host decides once whether it records a turn, and builds its line only
  when it does.
- One logfmt field type and one event-line writer serve the request event and
  the turn line.
- The settle a request's answer returns is built outside the draw, so it no
  longer keeps the draw's setup alive until its frame settles.
- The rate-limit vocabulary is back beside the function that produces it.
- The doctor's can-move text names a moving bar handed off to another lane,
  which the client's sighting now reads as the handoff line it drew.
feat(renderer): a statusline request is answered through Renderer.answer, in process, by the present its turn returns (candybar-host-renderer-x96a.2xo)

docs(design): Proposal 3, one host owns the world and renderers answer it (draft) (#710)

* docs(design): Proposal 3, one host owns the world and renderers answer it, with its intent stated to be falsified (candybar-gather-renderer-76bb.215)

* docs(design): goals record Brandon's intent with reasons, not his words, and the spec cites them by ID (candybar-gather-renderer-76bb.215)

* docs(design): Proposal 3 answers its first review: a total start, discovery as a value, Gather judges reads, every effect today has a home (candybar-gather-renderer-76bb.215)

* docs(design): Proposal 3 answers its second review: only a chain's own layer is writable, layers carry what their role can have, sessions run in their own environment (candybar-gather-renderer-76bb.215)

* docs(design): Proposal 3 answers its third review: a session's environment stays in the host and out of every recording (candybar-gather-renderer-76bb.215)

* docs(design): Proposal 3 names its concepts by their standard terms: functional core and imperative shell, subscriptions, conditional writes, profiles, mailboxes, an effect interpreter (candybar-gather-renderer-76bb.215)

* docs(design): Proposal 3 says collector and session context, and range ids belong to the tmux status row (candybar-gather-renderer-76bb.215)

* docs(design): Proposal 3 says world state for what the collector reads and handler for the renderer's one writer (candybar-gather-renderer-76bb.215)

* docs(design): goals.md says world state and handler, the names Proposal 3 uses (candybar-gather-renderer-76bb.215)

* docs(design): Proposal 3 names the renderer's one writer its state machine, since the URL handler already holds handler (candybar-gather-renderer-76bb.215)

* docs(design): Proposal 3 carries the step-back's decisions: digest range ids, writes only under the profile, chains of one-step effects, and the replay test after the pure draw (candybar-gather-renderer-76bb.215)

* docs(design): Proposal 3 can be built in order: range clicks have their own arm, write targets are named so an explicit config stays writable, step 3 builds the profile, and the request's wait lives in the mailbox (candybar-gather-renderer-76bb.215)
